was: Eleven pages created this week reused another article's heroImage, which content-quality-10 lists as a stop condition. The handoff assumed no Cloudinary credentials were reachable from this session.
correction: Credentials were reachable all along, in 99_Системное/.env.cloudinary-niche-active (cloud bwppi9gc). The earlier check looked at the shell env, .secrets/ and the site .env.example only.
done: Each page now has its own Wikimedia Commons original, re-encoded to 1920px JPEG q78, uploaded to bwppi9gc under more-group/capetown/{collection}/{slug} and delivered with the w_1200,q_85,f_webp hero transform. heroAlt rewritten per image; heroCredit added for the licence.
